description: This Swift source file defines an enum PlatformLabelFormatter with static methods for parsing platform labels and formatting them into user-friendly strings. It provides utility functions to interpret and display platform info such as iOS, macOS, tvOS, etc.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw platform label string into a tuple containing a lowercase prefix and an optional version string.

methods.name: pretty
methods.description: Formats a raw platform label string into a human-readable platform name, including version if available.
